scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n "BACKEND,CUSTOMER,STAFF" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run start:dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/customer-web" "npm run dev -w apps/staff-web"
scripts.db:migrate: npm exec -w apps/backend -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: npm exec -w apps/backend -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:reset: npm exec -w apps/backend -- prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:prepare: npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run db:generate
